metadata.name: Sharingan / 写轮眼
metadata.description:
See the whole floor. See where every point of damage comes from.
Sharingan provides a complete generated-floor map with ranked special-room colors and a compact combat report. It records the top five damage-dealing items, gives stat-up items only their measured DPS-delta share, and never counts the same damage twice. It also ranks what hurt the player and restores current-room combat records when Wheelchair Emergency Rewind is used.
MCM-configurable shortcuts. Defaults: F6 / Left Stick click. The map opens first; Left selects Map and Right selects Combat. Unvisited special rooms are vivid; visited rooms turn gray.
写轮眼让你看清整层地图，也看懂伤害来源。显示完整生成地图与特殊房间，记录本局伤害最高的五件道具； 属性道具只计算实际 DPS 增量，同一份伤害不会重复归属。支持 MCM 键盘/手柄快捷键，并与紧急回溯联动。 默认 F6 / 按下左摇杆；左键查看地图，右键查看战斗报告。
